d:
Beton ki chahat aur dashkon se bigarte linganupat ne hariyana men dulhanon ki kharid-farokht ka ek avaidh karobar khara kar diya hai. DW ki riportar aakanksha saksena un mahilaon se milti hain, jinhen shadi ke lie dusre rajyon se hariyana laya gaya aur jinmen se kaee hinsa, shoshan aur samajik bhedbhav jhel rahi hain.
Agar aapko vidiyo pasand aaya aur aage bhi aisi dilchasp vidiyo dekhna chahte hain to hamen sabsakraib karna mat bhulie.
